constraints: Do not fabricate provenance or weaken current commit enforcement
description: Efficient and resilient repository monitoring in existing repositories
rationale: PR #3 review exposed concrete failures in these workflows; agents and humans need reliable tools and honest applicability/verification data
requirements: Cache immutable commit results and the last exact governed working state only in the running watcher process
Invalidate changed snapshots and HEADs, report transient failures, and retry without silently accepting gaps
Report historical schema-pin differences separately while checking historical records and transitions with trusted current schemas
Keep current validation strict and provide an actionable non-ancestor diagnostic
title: Efficient and resilient repository monitoring
